Proposal 6 resolves the overly broad velocity-reset and mask descriptions: only XY are explicitly cleared, and 0xFFFE retains bits 1–15 rather than simply clearing bit zero without restricting higher bits.

Proposal 7 resolves the cross-file lifetime overstatement: local reference cleanup does not itself destroy the item, but the dispatcher can destroy it afterward based on the cached owner and flag x13.
